status: source review of Bonta's proposed coverage and future work
source_scope: 2024 second-edition manuscript page text, the twelve 2025 lecture captions, and the author's introductory letter. Exact author totals of fully read, partly read and unread inscriptions were not found in this source review.

proposed_signs_including_general_functio.qualification: Includes fish and oval families whose general function he interprets without identifying the unit names.

inscriptions_partly_read.author_statement: Most manuscript readings are partial; he considers a majority of the proposed P- and C-field readings complete within those fields.

inscriptions_unread.author_statement: A number of inscriptions may remain unreadable given the available evidence.

remaining_signs.author_statement: Dozens of rare signs and some common signs remain unresolved; he separately identifies common signs that may yield to further work.

existing_project_locator_count.qualification: This source index includes evidential examples, repeated citations, aliases and unresolved figure attachments. It does not identify a total of unique deciphered inscriptions.

cognitive_challenges.account: Recognizing patterns does not by itself explain the ancient practices behind the texts. The investigator must infer the purposes of objects and their notations without importing modern assumptions.
It is cognitively easier to identify a sign as resembling a bird or cow than to tabulate every occurrence and determine its distributional role.

cognitive_challenges.issue: Commitment to a preferred language or interpretation
cognitive_challenges.account: He warns against choosing the language in advance, forcing readings to fit, and explaining problematic results with improvised religious or cultural stories.

cognitive_challenges.issue: Large candidate spaces and limited human memory
cognitive_challenges.account: Cross-checking may require comparing thousands of lexical candidates across several contexts. He describes exhausting manual list comparison and incremental progress as additional anchors become available.
Brief repetitive texts reveal little connected grammar. A frequent sign confined to one environment can remain unconstrained; rare signs may supply too few comparisons.

proposed_next_work.target: Common signs with several different contexts
proposed_next_work.approach: Continue iterative cross-checking with existing provisional values, lexical candidates, positional patterns and visual evidence.

Develop a searchable database with more sophisticated comparison algorithms. His letter proposes AI informed by his preliminary findings and a substring-searchable database to cross-check deeper layers.
proposed_next_work.limit: He supplies a direction for AI assistance, not a specified VLM architecture, training procedure or benchmark.

proposed_next_work.approach: Clarify the three juncture signs, their possible case-like functions, and the four surrounding ticks used with enclosed fish and other signs.
Determine when a combined sign simply concatenates readings, incorporates only parts of constituent sounds, or overlaps with a related non-compound sign. Clarify the anthropomorphic component.
Replicate the comparison process and test assignments against inscriptions held aside or newly available. He reports developing against Mahadevan before consulting additional ICIT examples.
proposed_next_work.limit: The complete historical attempted validation set remains unresolved in the earlier project audit.

proposed_next_work.approach: Seek additional inscriptions, varied contexts and especially longer texts. He allows that some signs and texts may remain inaccessible without new material.
Invite further researchers to extend the work, especially researchers in India and Pakistan.
